name: c2_v1_v2_non_canonical_identity
description: PubKey y = 1 + p, a non-canonical encoding of the identity (V1, and V2 since the point is the identity). R = [S]B, S = 12345, nonce 0: [S]B - [k]I = R, so V6 holds with A entering SHA-512 as received. No parent, payload "v2 only". A verifier lacking both the canonicity part of V1 and V2 accepts it. Signature criteria (spec 3.2, evaluated by the generator): fails V1, V2; holds V3, V4, V5, V6.
